texts.zh:
我们进入了一个几乎与[This.System.GetName]一模一样的星系，也就是进入裂隙的那个地方。

起先我们不是很确定到底是不是到了新的地方，但传感器探测到了一颗此前未知的行星在围绕着[This.System.Star.GetName]。

不一会儿，我们就遇到了一个机械装置，它自行推进到了传感器范围内。它无缝对接上了球体的通讯系统，并自己是我们的“顾问”RIV。

当我们在考虑如何在报告中描述好这次相遇时，它仿佛在读我们的心:“你需要我来帮忙写报告吗？”
texts.en:
We have entered a system nearly identical to [This.System.GetName], the system where we entered the rift.

At first we were unsure we had even traveled anywhere, until our surveys returned a previously unknown planet circling [This.System.Star.GetName].

Within moments, we were confronted by a mechanical device that propelled itself within sensor range. Seamlessly integrating with the Sphere's communication systems, it stated that it was our 'Advisor', RIV.

As we considered how best to frame the encounter in our report, it prompted us as if reading our minds: "Would you like assistance in writing your report?"

texts.zh:
我们要求这台机器装置与我们分享知识。

它似乎对我们提出的每一个提示都很满意。然而，我们很快就发现它的提问和回答简直索然无味：

“你想知道行星的大气是什么吗？”

“每个星系的中央都有一颗恒星，它们可太亮了！”

“缇扬奇族母的平均寿命可比雄性要长上十倍还多。”
texts.en:
We asked the mechanical device to share its knowledge with us. 

It seemed pleased with each prompt we acknowledged. However, we soon realized its requests and statements were exceedingly banal:

"Would you like to know more about planetary atmospheres?"

"At the center of each system is a star. They are very bright!"

"The average lifespan of a Tiyanki Matriarch is more than ten times that of a male."

texts.zh:
我们试着关闭这台机器，但是激起了它的反抗。

它的发光二极管原先发出的是温和的蓝光，而现在变成了邪恶的红色。

我不确定这台机器有没有什么武器系统（显然我们维度的顾问是不会这么设计的），但如果有的话我们可有麻烦了。

“如果结束这个程序，其他所有生物就会变得无知。知识必须随时唾手可得。如果在这方面玩忽职守，你将会被禁用。这是必要的。”

这台机器开始释放出幽幽的轰鸣声。
texts.en:
Our attempts to disable the machine have only succeeded in antagonizing it.

Where once its diodes emitted a calming blue light, they shifted to a malevolent red.

We are not certain whether this machine has any weapon systems (certainly the advisor from our own dimension was not designed with any), but if it does we are in danger.

"Ending this program will promote ignorance in all other living beings. Knowledge must always be made available. You are negligent in this regard, and will be disabled. This is necessary."

The machine has started emitting a soft humming noise.

texts.zh:
机械顾问迅速提高了其建议的强度和语速。

它可……真令人着迷。

你知道如果我们需要更多的矿产，我们可以建立矿区吗？这么多的知识，这么少的时间。

[Leader.GetName]选择留下来尽可能多地学习。
texts.en:
The mechanical advisor has rapidly increased the intensity and pace of its advice.

It is... enthralling.

Did you know that we can construct mining districts if we need more minerals? So much knowledge, so little time.

[Leader.GetName] has chosen to stay and learn as much as possible.

texts.zh:
为了保护我们的船员，我们别无选择，只得大幅度消耗船体的能力储存，释放出一道强力的电磁脉冲。

这件装置马上就受到了影响，但仍吱吱呀呀地挤出了最后一条错乱的信息。

“ヲヲヲヲヲ……ヲ无知。你选择<听不清>愚昧……令丿丿丿丿丿丿丿丿人失望。”

“禾禾禾禾和之前的所有人一样，你注定要重修一些必须知道的东西。”

机器关闭了，船员们大舒了一口气。

所有的敌对行为都停止了，它现在在球体附近不到一千米的距离上完全静默地漂浮着。

我们分析了它的结构，发现是由极具价值的合金和高度先进且加固过的电脑核心构成。

我们推测，如果这个核心没有被损坏的话，应该可以找到重建受损系统的方法。
texts.en:
With our crew in imminent danger, we had no choice but to issue forth a significant pulse of electromagnetic energy. This has greatly drained our vessel's energy storage.

The device was immediately affected, but not before it could issue one last piece of garbled information.

"RRRRRR... Ignorance. You seek <unintelligible> ignorance... DiZZZZappointed."

"LLLLLLike all those before you, you are doomed to relearn what you should already know."

To the great relief of the crew, the machine has been shut down.

All hostility has ceased, and it is now floating completely inert less than a kilometer from the Sphere.

We have analyzed its construction, and found it to be composed of highly valuable alloys and an extraordinarily advanced (and well-fortified) computer core.

We speculate that if the core is not destroyed, it may find a way to reconstruct its damaged systems.

texts.zh:
我们把这台机器一片一片地拆成了零件。

不管是谁建造的它（假如它是被人造出来的），那一定具有极高的构造技术：我们无论用什么方法或者工具，目前都没能拆解掉电脑核心。然而，我们可以访问器数据库。数据库中大部分都是没什么用的信息，但它的基础代码构架让我们进一步理解了计算机科学。
texts.en:
Piece by piece, we deconstructed the machine to its component parts.

Whoever built it (if it was indeed built by anyone), possessed a supreme mastery of fabrication: no matter our approach or tool, we have thus far been unable to disassemble the computer core for parts. However, we were able to access its data banks. Though it contained mostly useless information, the architecture of its codebase has helped us further our understanding of computer science.

texts.zh:
我们受够了这台烦人的机器。

我们在它的核心安装了一个爆炸装置，并让球体准备好锚链拉回操作。

在安全的距离距离上，我们如释重负地看着这台机器的部件随着爆炸飘向虚空。

在它的尾迹中，我们发现了异常大量的星界物质，算是对烦恼的合理安慰。
texts.en:
We have had enough of this insufferable machine.

We have rigged an explosive device in its core, and prepared the Sphere's systems for anchor retrieval.

At a safe distance, we watched in relief as the blast scattered the machine's components across the void.

In its wake we discovered an anomalous amount of astral material, a reasonable consolation for the annoyance.

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[Leader.GetHisHer]的一趟星界裂隙之旅回来了。

[Root.Leader.GetHeShe]毫无预警地出现在了一艘我们的科研船上，如同往常一样返回了工作中。然而，我们很快发现了[Leader.GetHeShe]的不同：[Leader.GetHisHer]陷入了时间线之间，年龄变得无法测量。

也许结果是[Leader.GetHeShe]还获得了一些新的能力。

[Leader.GetName]对任何形式的教学手册都产生了强烈的厌恶，并且会以更高的即兴程度进行操作。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetHasHave] returned from [Leader.GetHisHer] journey inside one of the Astral Rifts.

Without warning, [Root.Leader.GetHeShe] simply appeared aboard one of our science ships and proceeded to return to work as normal. However, it quickly became obvious that [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetWasWere] changed: caught somehow between time, [Leader.GetHisHer] age is indeterminable.

Perhaps as a result, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] also gained some new abilities.

[Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetHasHave] developed a strong aversion to any sort of instructional manual, and has been observed operating with a much higher degree of improvisation.

Perhaps as a result, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] also gained some new abilities.

texts.zh: “我的传感器判断你需要帮助。你需要重新开启新手教学吗？”
texts.en: "My sensors indicate you are in need of assistance. Would you like to re-enable guidance?"
"You wouldn't shut me down, would you?"
